description: Presidential Secretariate - Award of Weerodara Vibhushanaya on the 02.10.2017 to the Warrant Officer Y. M. S. Yaparathne
categorisation: This gazette exclusively announces a personnel change - the conferral of a gallantry award to a named individual (Warrant Officer YMS Yaparathne). It names the President as the awarding authority but does not describe any structural changes to government or detailed portfolio responsibilities. The content focuses solely on the recognition of an individual's service, fitting the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
